findingDetails: Kimi exists only in the provider enum/prototype metadata; the production provider factory rejects it and task creation exposes only DeepSeek.

Kimi ListMessages associates conversation and page cursor in POST body rather than the response URL; passive capture needs a bounded allowlisted identity projection. No credentials or raw request bodies should be retained.

observations: Definition official origin https://www.kimi.com; endpoint /apiv2/kimi.gateway.chat.v1.ChatService/ListMessages, POST body chat_id/page_token.
Lexical richtext composer, .send-button-container and explicit new-chat controls. Do not copy upstream execCommand; use existing native input and exact readback.
Upstream finished detection uses status.endsWith(term), which accepts an unfinished suffix; NAND must use explicit finished status values.
Upstream joinDistinct drops repeated public text blocks; preserve repeats.
Upstream network replay and anonymous DOM identity/native-copy fallback are outside this passive native adapter. Pagination without complete request chain and current branch evidence stays partial.

implemented: Finite passive POST request projection before retaining response evidence: only conversation ID and cursor, exact HTTPS origin/endpoint/method, bounded body and maps; no request secrets or credential replay.

Kimi public text blocks preserve repeated content and Markdown, exact terminal statuses reject UNFINISHED; observed cursor chain, current DOM branch, parent identity, role order and page/count bounds prevent false completeness.

Kimi readonly DOM reader recognizes lexical/contenteditable input, explicit stable message/parent identities and public answer scope; no anonymous IDs, index identities or inferred parents. Native input uses the existing guest operation queue and exact readback.

Shared NativeProviderSession preserves the existing page/profile/generation admission, native input, pause, acceptance proof, capture and disposal lifecycle for both providers. Provider adapters lazy-load only when explicitly connected.

Provider selection in the registered production task API/UI; canonical Kimi URLs; unchanged durable workspace task/turn/answer storage and send journal. Unsupported providers rejected before task write.

Incomplete answer reasons exposed in bilingual result UI; title, draft, selected/visible recipients, independent submission/acquisition/save states, Markdown and restart behavior stay in the same workspace.
